Features

A powerful layer on top of the bookmarks you already use.

BarShift keeps Chrome as the source of truth and gives your bookmark bar the profile system it always should have had.

Real Chrome bookmarks. Always.

Your profiles stay normal Chrome bookmark folders. No separate bookmark database and no proprietary cloud layer.

Switch instantlyMake another profile become your visible bookmark bar.
Stay compatibleChrome remains the source of truth for your bookmarks.
Keep your workflowUse the browser you already know, just organized better.

Fast profile switching

Move between work, private, study, gaming, projects and more without digging through folders.

Save pages anywhere

Save the current page to the active profile or send it directly to another profile.

Profiles your way

Icons, colours, descriptions, pinning, hiding and search keep large setups easy to scan.

Power-user controls

Compact mode, bookmark counts, keyboard commands, toolbar badge and right-click saving.

Private by design

How it works

Save where it belongs — without breaking your flow.

Choose a destination profile directly from BarShift and keep browsing. The page stays a normal Chrome bookmark.

Privacy

Your bookmarks stay in your browser.

BarShift is built around Chrome’s own bookmark and extension storage APIs. It does not operate an external bookmark database.
